task: Mobile: make the Manual/listening status a compact inline badge next to the heading instead of a full-width row, and tighten the gap between Mode and the manual-line bar

public/index.html.summary: Moved #railStatus in the DOM to be a child of .railTop, right after .railBrand and before .railActions, instead of a sibling row below railTop. Same ids/classes, same JS bindings -- no behavior change to what updates it.

public/styles/responsive.css.summary: At <=900px, .railTop is now flex-direction:row (brand + status inline) instead of the default column, and .railStatus is flex:0 0 auto so it stays a compact badge rather than stretching full-width. Removed the stale <=640px override that forced .railTop back to a column with a 6.5rem min-height and wrapped .railActions -- both predated the full-screen redesign and are no longer needed (3 icons already fit in one row at 375px). Added margin-bottom:-0.4rem to .modeBar to tighten its gap to #manualBar specifically, without shrinking the shared .meetingShell gap used between the other chrome pieces.

test/public/style.test.js.summary: Removed assertions pinning the removed <=640px .railTop/.railActions stacking rules; added assertions for the new inline .railTop row layout, compact .railStatus, and .modeBar's tightened margin-bottom.
